Players Committee card image of [[Ochi (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Bestoon Legacy, it is immune to attrition < 5. While [Episode VII] Emperor on table, your total power here is +3. If opponent's character was just placed out of play, opponent loses 1 Force.” Uploaded unchanged.
